description: This file implements a Screen Recording Service for macOS, utilizing ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation to capture screen video and optional audio streams. It provides functionality to start, stop, and save screen recordings with configurable parameters.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: Enumeration defining possible errors during screen recording, including no displays, invalid screen index, no frames captured, and write failures.

classes.name: StreamRecorder
classes.description: A helper class responsible for managing AVAssetWriter for encoding video and audio streams, handling sample buffer processing, and finalizing the recording.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Main function to initiate a screen recording session, capturing specified display, handling duration, FPS, audio inclusion, and output path.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Asynchronous method to finalize and finish writing the recorded media to disk.
